name: Silly Lionfish 21
author: jeremyssocial
description: Neon gradient 3d rounded red button that rotates on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes translateZ(-40px), transform becomes rotateX(15deg) rotateY(15deg), transform becomes rotate(360deg) translateZ(10px). On focus, the outline is removed, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 4px #ff4b2b.
